help.pages.first: 1 Overview · 2 Proxies · 3 Profiles (keys enter page content)
help.navigation.tab: Tab / Shift+Tab: next / previous control; navigation and each list form one stop.
help.navigation.arrows: Sidebar ↑↓ / j/k: switch pages; → / l / Enter: focus content without activating a control.
help.navigation.scroll: Sidebar Home / End: first / last page. In content, PgUp / PgDn / Home / End navigates or scrolls the current view.
help.navigation.cancel: Esc returns one layer; ordinary content and vertical lists also accept ← / h. Horizontal controls keep their own keys. Ctrl+C cancels safely and quits.
help.proxies.expand: On a group, Enter expands or collapses it. Collapsing returns to the directory on narrow screens. In a Selector group, Enter selects the focused member. Esc returns to the previous view.
help.proxies.options: DIRECT and REJECT are valid choices. ↑↓ / j/k moves to the nearest column in the adjacent row; ←→ / h/l moves within the row first. At row edges, →/l enters an available reference group and ←/h goes back.
help.profiles.add: Press a to enter a subscription URL or local file path. Import saves the profile with an automatic name.
help.profiles.import: Choose New to enter a source and optionally set a name and description.
help.profiles.rename: Settings lets you change the name, description and source together. A custom name survives subscription updates.
help.profiles.grid: Use arrows or hjkl to browse cards. Enter opens settings. Esc returns to the card.
help.profiles.actions: Tab and Shift+Tab move between controls.
help.profiles.update: Update reads the saved source. Changes to the current profile take effect automatically.
help.profiles.overrides: Edit overrides keeps your changes across subscription updates. Open Settings to import overrides from a file.
help.profiles.delete: Confirm Delete to remove the profile.
help.connections.keys: List: / search · v active/closed · s next sort · S reverse · p pause/resume display. Click a column to sort, again to reverse, and a third time for newest first. Enter opens the focused connection; Esc returns from details.
help.connections.confirm: Close all affects every live connection, including those hidden by a filter or pause. Cancel is selected by default. Use Tab to choose, Enter or Space to activate, y to confirm, or Esc to cancel.
help.rules.keys: / searches · g / Ctrl+R reloads rules. On a focused rule, Enter shows hidden content, if any, or collapses it; Esc also collapses it.
help.rules.readOnly: Effective rules are read only. Expansion reveals the full rule text, not the contents of a rule collection. Open Rule collections in the header to inspect or update providers.
help.settings.ports: Service and ports: edit local proxy and control API ports.
help.settings.review: Review changed listeners and restart impact before applying; existing API credentials remain private.
help.settings.persistence: Autostart is shared with the CLI. Set it independently of whether the core is running.
help.settings.tun: Change routing mode in Overview or Proxies. The system instance manages host TUN from Overview.
help.logs.keys: f pauses/resumes display · End resumes at the latest entries · / searches · l opens the level menu · v toggles line wrapping · Ctrl+L clears · Ctrl+R reconnects. Space also pauses/resumes when the log list is focused.
help.logs.levelMenu: The level menu offers All, Info, Warn and Error, with the current value checked. Use ↑↓ / j k or Home / End to move, Enter to choose, or Esc, Tab or an outside click to cancel. Selection only filters the local view; capture stays unchanged.
help.logs.search: Search options: Aa matches case, underlined ab matches whole words, and .* enables regular expressions. Alt+C / Alt+W / Alt+R toggle these options while searching or browsing; they only filter retained logs and do not change capture.
help.logs.liveOnly: Capture continues across pages, help and display pauses. The log stream reconnects automatically. Logs missed during a disconnection cannot be recovered.
help.logs.retention: The view retains at most 200 redacted entries in memory. No raw log history is written.
help.overview.install: i: install/manage core · b: install a local executable
help.overview.import: n: download method · a: add/import profile
help.overview.controls: Focus Start or Stop and press Enter or Space to control the core. An em dash means the action is unavailable.
help.overview.refresh: Controls refresh the observed state after the operation.
help.overview.unavailable: In Network settings, choose Edit beside an item to open its configuration. Activate its status to switch it on or off. Host TUN requires the root system instance and explicit confirmation.
help.core.title: Core and configuration
help.core.actions: While browsing content: s starts · x stops · r restarts the core.
help.core.quit: Quitting closes this interface; systemd continues to own Mihomo.
help.forms.title: Forms and dialogs
help.forms.keys: Tab / Shift+Tab: change controls · Enter: activate · Esc: back
help.forms.input: Inputs, editors, dialogs and menus handle their own keys; printable keys, including q, ? and 1–7, belong to the active input.
help.forms.modal: Modal dialogs capture input and restore the previous page on close.
help.messages.title: Messages
help.messages.retention: Errors remain across pages and later operations until closed. Success lasts 3 visible seconds; info lasts 4.
help.messages.shared: Installation and network configuration use the same application use cases as the CLI.
